title: Godot hangs on closing running Forward+ Projects on Certain GPUs
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.7.dev1.mono.official [bf95b6258]
v4.7.stable.mono.official [5b4e0cb0f]
v4.7.1.stable.mono.official [a13da4feb]
v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]
v4.8.dev1.official [ebbf577a0]
Probably everything between 4.7.dev1 and stable (I didn't test them all)

Not reproducible in:
v4.6.3.stable.mono.official [7d41c59c4]
Earlier 4.x builds

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU - Intel(R) Core(TM) 7 250H (20 threads) - 31.18 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When I run a project in 4.7, while the project itself runs correctly, as soon as I close it Godot will hang, and can only be closed using the system monitor (which itself can't even fully kill the process but can at least close the window, which leads to my next restart of my computer taking a really long time, but I digress).

I'm aware this is probably a case of "doesn't work on my machine" but I have a history in working in QA and I am more than willing to help with the testing (although I might be slow to get to it at times due to a busy work schedule)

### Steps to reproduce

1.  Load any project that uses the Forward+ Renderer
2.  Run it
3.  Close the running Window
4.  Godot will hang.
I assume these steps won't work on every computer (I have no other computers I can test on) but probably require the same/similar GPU/driver.

[Mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30127492/Mrp.zip)
